macro_phases.name: Strategy is assessed for the portfolio

gates.name: Research Intake
gates.purpose: Reviews whether a strategy source and its extracted ideas are ready to enter the validation pipeline.

gates.name: Build & Spec
gates.purpose: Confirms that the trading system builds correctly and that its mechanical specification is complete before backtesting.

gates.name: Baseline Screening
gates.purpose: Screens whether the strategy produces a meaningful, profitable signal across its intended markets before deeper validation.

gates.name: Parameter Sweep
gates.purpose: Tests whether the result persists across a stable parameter neighbourhood rather than depending on a single tuned setting.

gates.name: Walk-Forward + Commission
gates.purpose: Uses walk-forward testing with a realistic venue cost model to check whether the strategy generalises beyond development data.

gates.name: Gross Full-History Robustness
gates.purpose: Replays robust parameters across the full available history to test whether the edge persists across market regimes.

gates.name: Stress HARSH
gates.purpose: Applies execution stress to test whether the strategy remains reliable when fills are disrupted.

gates.name: Multi-Seed
gates.purpose: Repeats the test across multiple random seeds to distinguish a genuine signal from lucky execution ordering.

gates.name: Davey Statistical Validation
gates.purpose: Combines statistical and robustness checks into a target-neutral evidence dossier for the frozen baseline.

gates.name: Baseline Full Run
gates.purpose: Freezes a full-history pre-news baseline as the reference for the later sealed comparison.

gates.name: News Impact + FTMO Recommendation
gates.purpose: Uses controlled news-condition comparisons to select a news mode and assess venue compliance.

gates.name: Incumbent Full-History Confirmation
gates.purpose: Confirms the locked configuration over full history with realistic costs and the selected news mode.

gates.name: Pattern Filter Selection
gates.purpose: Evaluates preregistered pattern filters while allowing the unfiltered strategy to remain the valid choice.

gates.name: Parameter Optimization & Freeze
gates.purpose: Optimises numerical parameters on development data and freezes the selected configuration for independent comparison.

gates.name: Best-Settings Head-to-Head
gates.purpose: Compares the frozen challenger with its baseline and incumbent to decide whether to promote it or keep the incumbent.

gates.name: Final Portfolio Construction
gates.purpose: Evaluates correlation, tail behaviour, clustering, marginal contribution and fit within an authorised portfolio.

gates.name: Operational Readiness
gates.purpose: Runs the operational pre-flight that must pass before an approved portfolio can proceed toward deployment.

gates.name: Live Burn-In DXZ
gates.purpose: Observes the approved strategy in live burn-in under monitoring and kill-switch controls before full live use.
